additional.scope: Additional active, size-stratified default-DEX BTC accounts; not representative of all traders

specification.candidate_order: Lexicographic public recentTrades participants; exclude original frozen accounts
specification.scope: Additional active, size-stratified default-DEX BTC accounts; not representative of all traders
specification.selection_within_stratum: Lexicographic address; no historical/future PnL or performance labels

original.scope: Size-selected current active default-DEX accounts, not a market-wide or performance-selected sample

specification.discovery: Public recentTrades for BTC, ETH, SOL and HYPE; inspect first 48 lexicographically sorted addresses; freeze up to 12 by current default-DEX gross position notional, never by PnL

specification.accounting: Fixed-notional nonoverlapping paired event study, not a funded portfolio NAV. Quote spread, assumed slippage and entry/exit fees are charged. Unknown active outcomes are not zero returns and block readiness for review.
specification.bootstrap: First response per account seeds historical IDs. Those fills never become eligible signals. New fills retain immutable first receipt; event time must be after trial start.
specification.control: Long if current recorded spot midpoint exceeds the recorded midpoint 15 minutes earlier; otherwise valid flat.
specification.decision_timing: First completed source batch in each UTC quarter-hour, after coverage warmup. An abstention consumes the bucket. At most one paired entry/outcome can be pending; no retroactive decisions.
specification.design: One predeclared prospective hypothesis and price-momentum control; no performance-selected wallets, threshold tuning or historical signal backfill.
specification.funding: Zero by instrument definition: fully funded long/flat spot, no leverage, borrowing or perpetuals.
specification.hypothesis: Positive sampled executed BTC TWAP base flow over the preceding 15 minutes predicts a positive subsequent 15-minute fully funded spot long return after assumed costs.
specification.limits: Sampled accounts are not independent owners or the whole market. Recent-list source coverage is inferred under the vendor contract, not venue-wide completeness. Parent TWAP remaining size/cancellation and external hedges are unknown.
specification.price_references: First valid recorded bid/ask whose event and receipt follow the entry/exit due time, within 30 seconds. Entry ask and exit bid with displayed size gate; quotes are not guaranteed fills.
specification.promotion: Never automatic. Meeting sample thresholds only permits further review; it does not validate alpha or enable orders.
specification.source: Native Hyperliquid userTwapSliceFills, the existing two frozen cohorts deduplicated into 22 public accounts.
specification.source_gates: All frozen accounts successful; 15 minutes of contiguous observed polls; actual ID overlap between nonempty histories; capped responses must reach the feature-window start; late/conflicting/future fills and stale/crossed/undersized quotes remain unknown.
specification.strategy: Long if the signed sum of eligible, deduplicated BTC slice base sizes is strictly positive; otherwise valid flat.
